lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canada’s new partnership with the European Union is meant to provide benefits to people on both continents, The Canadian Press reports.
The federal government has listed the Port of Vancouver’s planned Roberts Bank Terminal 2 expansion as a project of national interest, The Canadian Press reports.
Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says high-profile separatist leader Jeff Rath has been kicked out of her United Conservative Party, The Canadian Press reports.
Canadian tipsters could be part of a newly filed class-action lawsuit brought against Crime Stoppers due to a data breach, Daily Hive reports.

The top federal prosecutor in Alaska confirmed Friday the existence of a criminal investigation related to an alleged scheme to confuse voters by putting a Senate candidate on the ballot with the same name as the Republic, The Associated Press reports.
Long accused of abetting crypto crimes, Binance has now become a victim, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
